Position Summary
We are seeking a skilled React Native Developer to join AuricEdge Technologies, a fast-growing enterprise focused on building scalable mobile platforms for logistics and field operations. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining cross-platform mobile applications using React Native, TypeScript, and JavaScript. This role will work closely with product managers, backend engineers, QA, and UX designers to deliver high-quality features for users in complex, data-driven environments. The position requires an engineer who is comfortable working in an on-site, collaborative setting and can contribute to architectural decisions, performance optimization, and CI/CD for mobile releases.

Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Design
- Collaborate with product and engineering leadership to define mobile architecture and component libraries that support rapid feature delivery across Android and iOS.
- Translate UX flows and business requirements into scalable, maintainable React Native components and modules.
- Ensure clean separation of concerns, modularization, and adherence to coding standards and best practices.

Development & Implementation
- Lead end-to-end development of new features and enhancements in the React Native codebase using TypeScript and JavaScript.
- Implement robust client-side logic, UI components, animations, and offline-first behaviors as required by field operations workflows.
- Integrate mobile applications with backend APIs, real-time data feeds, and local storage mechanisms.
- Own bug fixes, performance tuning, memory and battery optimizations, and platform-specific adjustments.

Testing, Quality & CI/CD
- Develop and maintain unit and integration tests; collaborate with QA to ensure high test coverage and reproducible test plans.
- Participate in code reviews, pair programming sessions, and continuous improvement of the CI/CD pipeline for mobile builds and releases.
- Ensure app stability and quality through regression testing, crash analytics review, and monitoring of production issues.

Collaboration & Delivery
- Work closely with product, design, and backend teams to plan sprints, estimate tasks, and deliver on committed milestones.
- Mentor junior engineers, share knowledge of mobile best practices, and contribute to internal documentation and onboarding materials.
- Participate in incident response and postmortem activities for any production mobile issues.

Required Qualifications

Experience
- 3-6 years

Technical Skills (Required / Mandatory)
- React Native
- TypeScript
- JavaScript

Preferred Qualifications (Good-to-have)
- Experience with Firebase is a plus.
- Familiarity with Redux for state management is desirable.
- Prior exposure to Expo can accelerate onboarding.
- Experience writing tests with Jest is advantageous.

Success Metrics
- Timely delivery of mobile features as measured by sprint commitments and release deadlines.
- Improvement in app stability: measurable reduction in crash rates and critical bugs in production.
- Performance gains: reduced load times, lower memory usage, and improved battery characteristics on target devices.
- Test coverage and CI adoption: increase in automated test coverage and decreased manual regression effort.
- Developer productivity: reusable component library, clear documentation, and reduced cycle time for new feature implementation.

Location and Work Mode
- Bengaluru, on-site 5 days a week. No remote option.
